description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Ordinance Excise Notification No. 04/2023, Excise Duty on Liquor
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new excise duty rates on various types of liquor through the exercise of regulatory powers under the Excise Ordinance. It creates legally binding tax regulations that businesses must comply with, falling under the "Legal/Regulatory" category for regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, it does not focus on his appointment or portfolio responsibilities but rather on the regulatory content he is enacting.
